findings.text: the veto replay records recall 59 of 60 on both passes against the done-when's requirement of all 60 planted contradictions on two passes; both passes miss the same row, which the html attributes to the judge's reading without demonstrating it at a matched answer, so the recall bar the brief made a condition of the fix is measured unmet while the manifest reads complete.

the re-measured table renders per_class counts (30 not-acceptable, 47 acceptable) under the headers 'link-defect rows' and 'acceptable rows', but the bar's populations are 19 link-defect and 30 acceptable; the table's 30/28/47/6 cannot be reconciled with the verdict's 19/19 and 1/30 stated above it.

documentation_error_lint re-implements the exact composition that audits.py:778 run_lint_checks already owns (lexical lint, house style and documentation gates); it should call the owner, whose own docstring says the composition lives in one place.

the gate records only test_contradiction_veto_question.py and no baseline arm, while the brief required a delta against main on that file plus test_docs_gates.py and test_review_holds.py; the review-holds surface the jev_review changes can reach is therefore ungated.

item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when at prompt.txt:178 requires two passes with all 19 link-defect rows refined, none of 30 acceptable, the replay at at most 3/46 and 60/60, and a test failing on revert; the measurement log records all 19 and 1/30 and EXIT=0, but the replay records 59/60 on both passes (srtj-docs-switch-causes.json:1666,1671), so the measure is recorded and not met.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is 'Fix the veto and defining-relation causes of documentation over-refinement' (prompt.txt:36); the landed change fixes the veto cause across three sub-defects in jev_review.py, and deliberately does not change the defining-relation gate, recording that as the lead's policy call at srtj-docs-switch-causes.html:129-137, so half the stated goal remains open by design.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; manifest.md:13 records only the test_contradiction_veto_question.py gate and manifest.md:15 the negative-control log, and the manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite arm, so the delta against main the brief asked for is not recorded.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read manifest.md:3 and every path in the diff; jev_review.py, test_contradiction_veto_question.py, the runner, the html and the json are all inside the declared paths, and docs_gates.py and test_docs_gates.py were granted and not modified.

justifications.evidence: The measurement log records EXIT=0 and the JSON records per-class and replay results, but srtj-docs-switch-causes.json:1666 records recall 59 against the done-when's 60, and no baseline arm is recorded.
